name: 38011 · Brighton, TN
findings: ZIP 38011 (Brighton) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38011 (Brighton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 38011 (Brighton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
